def _passage_ranges(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    body = str(record.get("body") or "")
    matches = list(PAGE_RE.finditer(body))
    if not matches:
        trimmed = _trimmed_range(body, 0, len(body))
        return [trimmed] if trimmed is not None else []
    starts = [0, *(match.start() for match in matches[1:])]
    ends = [*(match.start() for match in matches[1:]), len(body)]
    return [item for pair in zip(starts, ends, strict=True) if (item := _trimmed_range(body, *pair))]

accepted.content: Paper records containing `## PDF page N` headings become exact page passages. The first passage includes any title preamble before PDF page 1. Other records retain one full-record passage. When such a record is at least 10,000 characters and contains a level-two Markdown heading, it also receives one exact overview passage from the body start to the first heading. Whitespace trimming changes every character bound so `record.body[start:end]` always equals the persisted text exactly.
